notes.title: Indie Otome Game "AROMA LOVE READY!" Is Now Available! Begin Your Aromatic Roman
notes.content: [p]Dear esteemed Perfumers![/p][p] [/p][p]After countless sleepless nights and with your unwavering support, our indie otome game Love & Perfume: Ready! has finally launched on Steam!![/p][p][/p][p]【Game Introduction】[/p][p]You play as an ordinary perfumer and anime-loving homebody, until a car accident lands you on the “Human Soul Transit Center’s” observation list. An angel, a demon, and a fallen angel—three handsome men are now by your side 24/7?! Behind the lighthearted daily life lies a cross-species conspiracy and budding romance…[/p][p] [/p][p]【Game Highlights】[/p][p] [/p][p]· Perfect for players looking to enjoy romance in a light-hearted comedic atmosphere～[/p][p]· Fully voiced! An immersive romantic experience～[/p][p]· 21 different endings! Your choices shape the story～[/p][p]· 250,000-word script! A blend of humor and heartfelt emotions～[/p][p]· Original theme song & multiple beautiful CGs waiting to be unlocked～[/p][p] [/p][p]【Launch Discount】[/p][p]Original price: $9.9[/p][p]First-week special: 10% off → only $8.9![/p][p] [/p][p]Follow the sweet fragrance… into new love and new adventures![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45327929/2cd7077f6f3e710b6060ebdca5e700d77ae239b2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 《香恋Ready!》摩点众筹于今天8月6日中午12点正式开启~！
notes.content: [p]各位调香师们大家好，咱们的独立乙女游戏《香恋Ready!》摩点众筹于今天8月6日中午12点正式开启啦~！（会截止到9月10日结束哦！）(◍•ᴗ•◍)ﾉ♡[/p][p]算起来，香恋的立项时间到现在已经3年了。[/p][p]作为一个四人学生团队(现在算半学生团队)，我们的制作成员也从一开始的大学生，变成了研究生或者打工人。因为平时大家都非常忙碌，有自己的主要工作和学业要完成，所以香恋的游戏制作工作都是在寒暑假大家有空的时间集中肝。其实，2023年我们就做出了香恋的雏形，之后一整年的时间都用在了重新梳理剧情上，和23年相比，现在的香恋几乎完全重做。[/p][p]作为一个新生游戏创作团队，我们走了不少弯路，也遇到了很多困难，一路跌跌撞撞走到了现在;不过，我们依然热爱这个项目，也希望这个项目能给大家带来开心愉悦的游戏体验~ 感谢一路走来大家对干香恋的鼓励和支持![/p][p]《香恋Ready!》是我们用3年碎片时间磨出的“孩子”，此前全靠团队成员们“为爱发电”支撑。我们逐渐意识到制作游戏的路上，筹备更丰富的美术、配音、音乐，进一步的程序优化太“烧钱”，也太“烧时间”啦!虽然难以启齿，但是为了能够将整个项目按照我们的时间预期顺利完成，打造更好的演出效果，确实会需要一定的资金支持( ´•̥̥̥ω•̥̥̥` )[/p][p]因此，我们决定开启本次众筹项目--如果大家愿意资助，我们不仅能获得超大的能量，也将在这条路上走的更宽阔，尽我们所能回报大家的善意与支持，打磨更丰富的游戏体验并送出更多的福利~(๑ơ ₃ ơ)♥[/p][p]不过也请支持香恋的大家不要担心!!不管结果如何，我们都将在这条路上一直走下去，一定会把香恋肝完的!![/p][p]再次深深的感谢所有支持过项目制作的朋友，所有看到这里、玩过游戏的朋友，所有支持过我们的朋友-祝您玩得开心!生活顺遂(๑>︶<๑)[/p]

notes.title: "AROMA LOVE READY!" Demo Closed Today
notes.content:
Hello, Players! This is the official AROMA LOVE READY!! development team~ ₍ᐢ..ᐢ₎♡

Since the demo launched on Steam, we’ve received tons of feedback and suggestions from you—along with so much encouragement! Watching the wishlist grow day by day has been heartwarming, and we’re truly grateful for your trust and support. ꒰ঌ( ⌯' '⌯)໒꒱

Of course, we haven’t been idle during this time! We’ve been working nonstop to optimize and polish the game. ᕙ(`▿´)ᕗ

To ensure you all get an even better experience in the future, we’ve decided to temporarily close the demo today, March 31st. During this time, we’ll focus on further improvements and updates. Don’t worry—we’ll announce when the demo reopens! ❛‿˂̵✧

Once again, thank you for your incredible support. Your passion is what drives us forward! ✧｡ (ˊᗜˋ) ✧*｡ We’ll keep striving to deliver the best for you. ૮(˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)ა
